name: all pairs via allowed intermediate vertices
mechanism: for each vertex k in turn, update every pair's best cost to the better of the current value and going through k, so after all k every pair holds its shortest path cost

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Floyd–Warshall algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Graph algorithms / Routing for graphs: solves the all pairs shortest path problem in a weighted, directed graph

fails_when: cubic; negative cycles show as negative diagonals
